attempts.promptText:
STARBLOX CATALOG ART — A-TINY-RACK-ONE-PAIR

Create one premium, kid-friendly 2D game catalog asset with polished dimensional quality.

Exact metadata: decor-7 — Skate Rack; collection decor; type room; tier 3; theme Garden Glow.

Authoritative item-specific design brief:
Skate Rack, Room Decor, Tier 3, Garden Glow. ONE SMALL FREESTANDING roller-skate rack only on a plain studio background. Use exactly two thick warm-wood side posts, one broad floor base, and exactly THREE large open storage bays. Put exactly ONE matching pair of unmistakable quad roller skates together in the bottom bay; leave the other two bays empty. Each skate must have one clear boot upper, one toe stop, two axles and exactly four large visible round wheels, fully contained inside the bay. The rack frame must dominate the silhouette; add only one tiny leaf cutout and restrained green accent. NO wall grid, NO repeated cubbies, NO second rack, NO loose skates, NO boards, NO room scene, NO text.

Exact-hash reviewer failure taxonomy: UNKNOWN_REWORK.

Repair the documented failure codes while preserving qualities that were not implicated. Do not erase successful identity, silhouette, material depth, or readability merely to make a different image.

Use the exact catalog ID/name/collection/tier/theme. Do not rename, recategorize, or substitute the item.

Make the object unmistakably the stated product category with believable proportions and construction.

Prioritize a distinctive clean silhouette that reads immediately at small Store-card size.

Show real thickness, seams/joints/edges, layered parts, volume, contact points and functional construction—not a flat icon, emblem or sticker.

Use category-appropriate material texture and highlights/shadows that explain the form.

Express the exact theme through material, construction, light and motif—not a palette swap or pasted decal.

Respect tier progression: Starter stays simple and attractive; higher tiers gain richer form/material detail; Luxe gains spectacle without losing identity.

Design for both detail view and a 600×600 Store card with strong contrast, uncluttered hierarchy and no tiny critical details.

Avoid recolor-only siblings, repeated template silhouettes, generic rings/badges, or interchangeable props.

Present one isolated subject on a clean premium background. No UI, text, watermark, logo, fake price badge or unrelated props.

For furniture/decor, show supports, joints, cushions/panels/hardware, weight and grounded contact.

Use a clean product-style three-quarter view when appropriate so front, side and thickness are visible.

Use occlusion, contact/cast shadows and foreground/midground/background separation so the asset feels spatial.

Use controlled emissive light/bloom only where appropriate; preserve edges and local contrast.

For textiles, show weave/pile/folds/stitching/edge finish/thickness and believable softness or drape.

For wall decor, show mounting/frame/backing/relief depth and a believable wall-object form—not a floating emblem.

For lighting, show a physical base/mount/chassis, emitter or bulb, support structure and believable emitted/reflected light.

Output a production-worthy source image for exact-byte staging, card/detail rendering and independent review. Do not claim approval; the reviewer decides from rendered pixels.
